payload.summary: Caring Contacts: the workspace's first client boundary has no browser evidence that it hydrates
payload.detail: Found in the Phase 2B Task 7 review, 2026-08-25. The activation wizard (`src/components/caring-contacts/workspace/plan-wizard/`) is the first deliberate Client Component in this workspace; every other screen is a Server Component that works with JavaScript disabled. Its draft state uses `useSyncExternalStore` with a `getServerSnapshot`, and that hydration argument is the most novel thing in the diff. All six new Playwright cases land on the no-referral state, and one explicitly asserts `caring-contacts-plan-wizard` has count 0 — so the boundary is proved in jsdom only, which has no RSC payload and performs no hydration. The implementer's reason for not fabricating a referral id is sound and was accepted: the isolated Playwright server seeds no referrals, and a fabricated id would have rendered the identical screen while claiming to prove a stage. So this is a genuine coverage gap rather than a shortfall in the task. Close it when something in the workspace lists referrals and a browser case can reach the wizard with a real one — at that point assert the wizard mounts, a draft value survives a reload, and the notice renders.
